title: Career Personality & Interest Profiler
description: Explore your personality, interests, strengths, preferences, and work style to discover career directions that may suit you.
instructions: Read each statement or scenario and choose the option that best reflects how you naturally work and think. There are no right or wrong answers.

title: Photo Career Quiz
description: Explore careers through side-by-side workplace photos. Pick the photo that appeals to you more in each pair.
instructions: Each question shows two workplace scenes side by side. Click the photo representing the activity or environment you would enjoy more, then click Next.

title: Career Discovery Quiz
description: Discover possible career directions through your favourite subjects, skills, interests, values, and preferred working environment.
instructions: Choose the school subjects, skills, and work settings that feel most like you. Some questions allow selecting multiple answers.
